correctness.rationale: The alternating triples distinguish four runs (both present), three (one, fixing the start), and at most two (neither); letter totals and ordered pairs recover these shorter cases. For four runs starting in zero, the deck supplies Z=a+c, O=b+d, P=N10=bc, N010=aP and N101=dP, which recover all four exponents at fixed orientation. For a same-deck word starting in one, put Q=N01 and rho=P/Q. Pair balance gives P+Q=ZO and the alternating triples give opposite end exponents rho*d,rho*a. The product of its two middle exponents is (Z-rho*a)(O-rho*d)=Q+rho(rho-1)ad since Zd+Oa=Q+ad. As that product must equal Q, rho=1 and the word is the reversal. Counting zeros before and after individual ones (and vice versa) gives the two triple-difference identities, so the reversal is equivalent precisely when N01=N10, or 2bc=ZO. Dividing b(c-a)=d(a+c) by gcd(c-a,c+a) gives the positive solutions, with c>a. Each labeled unordered reversal pair has a unique zero-start representative, so the listed parameters are nonredundant for labeled pairs; complement is an involution on the family, not an additional nonredundant list if one further quotients by complement. Independent direct enumeration of all 510 binary words of lengths 1–8 found zero collisions through length 6, exactly two reversal pairs at 7, and eight nonreversal pairs at 8. The specified witness has the stated deck and run counts 4 and 5. Thus the theorem is sharp in both stated senses, not a claim that the first collision of any kind has length 8.
residual_risks: The replay covers the finite cutoff only; the rigidity theorem beyond it is proved algebraically.
The assumptions require both words to be in the four-run class when deducing reversal rigidity.

value.rationale: Reconstruction from subsequence multiplicities has a natural restriction by the number of symbol changes. The proof delineates the last bound with uniqueness up to reversal, classifies exactly which reversals it cannot distinguish, and shows by a minimal nonreversal witness what fails when the run bound is increased. The arbitrary-length classification, not the small finite enumeration alone, is the substantive contribution.
residual_risks: No classification of unrestricted or all five-run fibres, robustness to noisy decks, or extension to larger alphabets is asserted.
